_readme: How the Lens Finder prices ZEISS/synchrony rows and orders its results. Copy to config/lens_pricing.json to change per machine (git-ignored); the example is used when no copy exists. promo_until: the launch level (price_promo column, L50) applies while today is BEFORE this date, then the ongoing price (deal price, or book at L25). prefer_stock: put a stock lens that fits ahead of a cheaper grind (practice rule, Sep 2026 — stock keeps the job in the finished range and off the surfacing bench); false = cheapest first. zeiss_mix_suppliers: which suppliers count toward the ZEISS-brand purchase mix in the bundle agreement (synchrony assumed to count — unconfirmed).
_stock_combined_confirmed: false until VISUSTORE confirms ZEISS stock bands read as sphere + cyl (key -4.00/-4.00 ClearView FSV 167: accepted on 70 mm?). While false, a stock band needs the printed sphere reading AND the combined reading to agree (lenses/README.md).

levels._note: multipliers on the L20 book; L50 21 Oct 2026 - 20 Apr 2027, then L25: Trisha written summary 20 Oct 2026
